description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ModelTraitTest' for testing serialization models and traits within the OrangeHRM API V2 Serializer component, including tests for nested attribute arrays, filters, and attribute name mappings. It also defines several test entity and model classes to facilitate the tests.

classes.name: TestJobTitleEntity
classes.description: A simple mock entity class representing a job title with name and description properties.

classes.name: TestEmployeeEntity
classes.description: A mock entity class representing an employee, with ID and job title, used for testing nested serialization.

classes.name: TestJobTitleModel
classes.description: A test model implementing Normalizable, utilizing ModelTrait, for testing serialization of TestJobTitleEntity.

classes.name: TestEmployeeModel
classes.description: A test model implementing Normalizable, utilizing ModelTrait, for testing serialization of TestEmployeeEntity, including nested entities.

classes.name: TestModel
classes.description: A minimal test class that uses the ModelTrait to facilitate private method invocation tests.

methods.name: testSetEntity
methods.description: Tests setting an entity in the model and converting it to an array with only the name property.

methods.name: testSetFilters
methods.description: Tests setting filters on the model and verifying that only filtered fields are included in the output.

methods.name: testSetAttributeNames
methods.description: Tests remapping attribute names in the model and verifying array output keys.

methods.name: testToArrayWithChaining
methods.description: Tests nested entity serialization, recursive attribute mapping, and filtering using chainable method calls on the model.

methods.name: testMakeNestedArray
methods.description: Tests the private method 'makeNestedArray' for constructing nested arrays based on attribute paths.
